title: whatsapp_inbox.templates.import_from_meta
description: A template that exists at Meta (created in WhatsApp Manager) and not in this hub, with its text and Meta's verdict, as the SaaS door lists it. Lands only if this hub has no row — live or deleted — with the same name and language.

variables.description: JSON array, one example value per {{n}} of the body

meta_status.description: Meta's verdict as Meta words it (APPROVED, PENDING, REJECTED…). Not an enum, for the same reason as in template_record_meta_answer.json.

header_format.description: TEXT, or the kind of file the header carries (whatsapp_inbox#180). The file itself is chosen when a message is sent.

buttons.description: JSON array of the template's buttons in Meta's order: {type: QUICK_REPLY|URL|PHONE_NUMBER, text, url?, phone_number?}
